scope: Source-contract checks only. These are NOT frame captures, Compose builds or device tests.

checks.name: only the two persistent root nodes capture UI backgrounds
source attachment readiness does not swap composable material branches
Haze effect remains mounted for a stable source
menus do not create Android Popup windows
dialogs do not create Android Dialog windows
overlay captured composition locals remain current
menu geometry is computed directly in one measure pass
opacity is independent of spring overshoot
theme/material selection runs after menu fade finishes
retained settings home exists below conditional detail
predictive cancellation uses an animation rather than an immediate reset
only active page and section publish navigation scroll state
row ripple is not captured as a bright patch during navigation
private dialogs still request screenshot protection
same-window overlay owns back and outside click
inactive page remains visually present but cannot accept clicks
